components.name: Tactile Re-Analyze Button
components.description: Full-width keycap button with top highlight bevel, icon rotation on refresh, and 1px active press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cbd5e1); border-radius: 9px; background-color: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #0f172a); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--surface-hover, #f1f5f9); border-color: var(--text-muted, #475569); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0284c7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 7px; background-color: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-muted, #475569); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--text, #0f172a); border-color: var(--border-strong, #cbd5e1); background-color: var(--surface-hover, #f1f5f9); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0284c7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tabular Version Token Chip

components.css: .ds-chip-version { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3); background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #10b981; }

components.css: .ds-readout-bay { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); overflow: hidden; } .ds-readout-main { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; } .ds-beacon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3); background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; flex: 1; } .ds-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #0f172a); margin: 0; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3); background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #10b981; } .ds-domain-well { padding: 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); background-color: var(--bg-recessed, #f1f5f9); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted, #475569); }

components.name: Indeterminate Conic Spinner
components.description: Semantic <progress> activity ring using conic-gradient and border-area clipping.
components.css: .ds-spinner { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; appearance: none; border: 0; background: conic-gradient(from 90deg, #0284c7 158deg, transparent 0) #e2e8f0; mask-image: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 2.2px), black calc(100% - 2.2px)); }

narrative.overview:
Tailwind Detector treats browser extension telemetry like a high-precision developer instrument rather than a marketing widget. Every pixel inside the compact 320px frame is structured for immediate diagnostic scannability: the status beacon, the semantic headline, and the tabular version chip live inside an elevated readout bay, while the inspected hostname sits in a recessed monospace console well below.

The visual system rejects floating glowing circles, decorative gradients, and ungrounded pill clouds in favor of structural 1px borders, tactile keycap buttons with subtle top highlights, and crisp state-driven semantic accents. Light mode reads like a clean laboratory specification sheet on cool slate paper; dark mode shifts into a deep carbon DevTools chassis.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument Bay Framing: Primary status and domain telemetry share a unified card container (12px radius) split by a structural 1px hairline into an elevated status header and a recessed domain well.
Tabular Version Telemetry: Version tags (v4.0.14, v4.x) and toolbar badges (v4.0, v3.4) use monospace numerals (tabular-nums) and optical cap-height trimming (text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic).
Tactile Keycap Controls: Interactive buttons combine a 1px structural border, a soft drop shadow, an inner top highlight bevel, and a physical 1px press translation.
State-Reactive Semantics: Emerald signals active Tailwind detection, Sky Blue marks clean non-detection or active scanning, and Amber warns of browser-protected pages.

rules.name: The Tinted-Slate Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text, icons, and borders must always carry the cool slate undertone (#475569 / #94a3b8) rather than dead neutral gray (#737373), keeping the HUD cohesive across themes.

rules.name: The Semantic Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Emerald (#059669 / #34d399) appears only when Tailwind CSS is confirmed on the active page; never use it for generic UI chrome or buttons.

rules.name: The Optical Cap-Trim Rule
rules.body: All compact badges, brand titles, and button labels apply text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic so vertical padding hugs the visible glyph bounds with zero ghost leading.

rules.name: The Tabular Version Rule
rules.body: Version strings in both the popup pill and toolbar badge use monospace or tabular-nums so digit widths never jitter during state updates.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: Never use zero-offset colored blur halos (0 0 20px) around status icons; communicate state through crisp 1px border tints and high-contrast surface fills.

dos: Do keep the popup focused strictly on the core diagnostic facts (detection state, version badge, active hostname, re-analyze trigger, theme toggle, and GitHub link).
Do format the toolbar icon badge (chrome.action.setBadgeText) with the concise version string (v4.0, v3.4, or v4) on a high-contrast Sky Signal (#0284C7) background with white (#FFFFFF) text.
Do use text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic on compact labels and badges so vertical alignment with icons is optically centered.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by slowing the indeterminate <progress> spinner rotation (6s) and collapsing transition durations.
donts: Don't add uppercase kicker or eyebrow labels above #statusTitle; let the status heading and version chip carry the hierarchy directly.
Don't use circular 50% radial glow orbs or 999px pill containers where the 6px–12px technical squircle grammar belongs.
Don't introduce external runtime dependencies, webfont network requests, or inline scripts that violate Manifest V3 CSP.
